parsed.title: Context Memory Boost
parsed.oneLiner: Unlock 30 minutes of 5x context memory for roleplay via a rewarded mini-game.
parsed.trigger: When the user lands on the memory paywall screen (s03) and is blocked from advanced context.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users reaching the memory wall.

offer.title: Unlock 5x Memory Now
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to get 5x context memory for the next 30 minutes.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly time-boxed to 30 minutes and capped at 2 uses per day, ensuring the monthly subscription remains the only way to get permanent memory [TAX-2] [CANN-2].
risks: Increased inference costs due to 5x context size per user session [TRIG-4].
Potential devaluation of the Janitor Plus subscription if 30 minutes satisfies core roleplay sessions.

evidence.quote: Access advanced chat memory and priority is blocked

newElements.change: Add a MiniGameButton styled as 'Try 30 mins for free' below the context feature description.
